sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: PAPI 硬體計數器：IPC 與事件可比性
related.titleEn: PAPI hardware counters: IPC and event comparability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：統計不確定性與工程可改善性分開列出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Statistical uncertainty and engineering improvability are stated separately.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「PAPI 硬體計數器：IPC 與事件可比性」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付事件映射、計數區間、IPC與elapsed對照及不可用事件清單。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct PAPI hardware counters: IPC and event comparability with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver event mappings, intervals, IPC/elapsed comparisons and unavailable events.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以2500/10000得到p，計標準誤及95%近似半寬，標明獨立假設。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Use 2500/10000 for p and compute standard error and approximate 95% half-width, stating independence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: AWS ParallelCluster：全數到位、啟動延遲與節點工時
related.titleEn: AWS ParallelCluster: complete allocations, launch delay and node-hours
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：統計不確定性與工程可改善性分開列出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Statistical uncertainty and engineering improvability are stated separately.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「AWS ParallelCluster：全數到位、啟動延遲與節點工時」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付16節點狀態表、三階段工時、部分容量反例及回收清單。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct AWS ParallelCluster: complete allocations, launch delay and node-hours with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver sixteen-node states, three-phase hours, partial-capacity counterexamples and cleanup lists.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以2500/10000得到p，計標準誤及95%近似半寬，標明獨立假設。
為16節點各畫20+120+10 min三階段，總分鐘除60。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Use 2500/10000 for p and compute standard error and approximate 95% half-width, stating independence.
Draw 20+120+10-minute phases for each of sixteen nodes and divide total minutes by 60.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
